solutionSql:
SELECT s.customer_id,
       i.id,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.customer_id ORDER BY i.amount DESC) AS amount_rank
FROM invoices i
JOIN shipments s ON s.id = i.shipment_id
ORDER BY s.customer_id, amount_rank, i.id;

rules.howSolved: DENSE_RANK partitioned by customer and ordered by amount DESC gives equal amounts the same rank.
DENSE_RANK leaves no gap after a tie, so the next distinct amount gets one more than the previous rank.

ambiguities: 'Highest first' is read as amount DESC, so rank 1 is each customer's largest invoice amount.
The final order key 'then invoice id' is read as ascending.
notes: Sample returns 205 rows, ties 154, precision 154. A cross-check using COUNT(DISTINCT amount) over larger amounts gives 0 differences on all three. amount_rank is bigint (type 20), as specified.
